reason: The quote states CloudTrail records user API activity with caller identity, call time, request parameters and response elements.
Context contrasts individual rules with conformance packs' additional benefit: rules plus remediation as one entity deployable org-wide, with pack-level reporting and immutability.
The quote states delivery from different accounts to one S3 bucket and notifications to one SNS topic in the same Region, each once IAM policies are applied.
The quote states both parts: no guarantee or prevention, but remediation actions per rule can restore compliance.
The quote states Config is turned on per Region for your account.
Under the heading on evaluating rules before provisioning, the quote says Yes, with proactive, detective or both modes; context points to the list of supporting rules.
The quote states only the latest configuration, representing the cumulative impact, is recorded for quick successive changes.
The quote states recording of software changes in EC2 and on-premises VMs or servers, including OS updates, network configuration and installed applications.
The quote states the rule represents desired configurations and is evaluated against recorded configuration changes.
The quote states evaluation only after change is completed and recorded, no prevention, and IAM policies and Service Catalog for control.
The quote states CIs answer what a resource looked like and CloudTrail answers who made the API call to modify it.
The quote states a fully managed service providing resource inventory, configuration history and change notifications for security and governance.
Quotes plus context state the SQL SELECT subset on current CI data, no service-specific describe calls, and aggregators running the same queries centrally across accounts and Regions.
Quotes state collection from multiple accounts and Regions, read-only view, no deploying rules or pushing snapshots, and no additional cost.
Context lists all three scopes including single account and multiple Regions; the org scope quote names accounts with Config enabled.
Quotes state retry when still noncompliant, retries only on failure within the specified period, and costs of running the script multiple times.
The quote states the point-in-time view, its components and creation whenever a change to a recorded resource type is detected.
Quotes state the recorder stores changes as CIs and the two types, with customer managed defaulting to all supported resources in the Region.
Quotes state the collection deployed as a single entity in an account and Region or org-wide, authored as YAML; context names the sample templates.
The quote states continuous and daily recording, daily giving the most recent state over 24 hours only if different from the previous CI.
The quote states the detailed view, relationships, past configuration and change over time.
Quotes and context state history files per recorded resource type sent regularly to the specified bucket, SNS notifications, and no lifecycle policy changes.
Quotes state central create, update and delete across accounts, non-modifiable via management account APIs, and API or CLI only, not the console.
Quote and table context state two modes, proactive before deployment, detective after, and that proactive rules neither remediate nor prevent deployment.
The quote states the default of CIs for every supported resource in the Region and the option to specify resource types.
Quotes state SSM Automation documents, managed and custom documents, and manual or automatic choice for all remediation actions.
Context says there are two types of rules; the table rows give managed rules and custom rules via Lambda or Guard.
The quote states flagging noncompliant resources with notification and continuous evaluation on create, change or delete.
Quotes state the IAM policy at any time Config was recording and security group port rules open at a specific time.
Quotes state streaming changes and notifications to SNS, compliance state, and the recorder and delivery channel prerequisite.
The quote states source accounts are individual or an organization, provided individually or retrieved through Organizations.
Quotes state Describe or List API calls and periodic examination to catch changes not initiated by the API.
Quotes state evaluation on configuration change or periodically, periodic at a chosen frequency, and hybrid with both.
The Organization Conformance Packs table gives 50 per organization and 130 rules per org pack, not increasable, and the note on child account limits.
The November 26, 2023 history row states periodic recording with Daily frequency, giving one CI for the last 24 hours only if it differs.

The quote is a worked US East example in which each resource changed 10 times; it does not make 'only 1 CI per resource per day' a general rule, since daily recording gives a CI only if the state differs, so it is at most one, not exactly one. The prices are supported as example figures.
Pricing example 1 is in US East (N. Virginia) and the quote gives $0.003 per continuous configuration item.
Pricing example 2 is in US East (N. Virginia) and the quotes give the first 100,000 rule and conformance pack evaluations at $0.001 each.
The quote states the three charge dimensions: CIs recorded, active rule evaluations and conformance pack evaluations.
The November 28, 2022 history row states proactive compliance checks against Config rules before resources are created or updated.
